source_fields.source_semantics_note: The project metadata CSV uses custom field names (wind, pressure, grade, long50, short50, etc.) and does not contain the standard IBTrACS v04r01 agency/source columns. Confirm provenance, wind unit, averaging period, and reference height before running Phase 7E.

wind_adjustment.note: Add 15 knots to each finite numeric source wind observation before wind-field reconstruction. Preserve original values; missing observations remain missing. This is an experimental offset, not a physical correction or calibrated bias adjustment.

rmw.note: No verified RMW field is available in the normalized track table. 30 km is a sensitivity assumption, not an observed or calibrated radius.

surface_wind_note: Use the source sustained wind value as the radial profile Vmax only after confirming that it represents a 10-m sustained wind. No conversion between 1-min, 3-min, or 10-min averaging periods is applied.
